notices.summary_row: Residential construction defect notice and repair process; written notice to home owner needed
notices.hold_reason: no prescribed wording; the statute only says the home owner must be given written notice of the requirements of 70-19-426, 70-19-428 and 70-19-427, with no sentence, format or timing set

notices.summary_row: Notice of right to cancel (cancellation card)
notices.title: Personal solicitation cancellation card, text part (3 business days)
notices.format: Printed in capital and lowercase letters of not less than 10-point boldfaced type with the seller's name and business address
notices.support: printed in capital and lowercase letters of not less than 10-point boldfaced type with the seller's name and business address and the statement set forth in subsection (1)(b)
notices.block: MCA 30-14-505. Notice of right to cancel
notices.start: YOU MAY CANCEL THIS SALE WITHIN THREE BUSINESS DAYS.
notices.quote_note: None: the statute does not use quotation marks. The paragraph label (a) is left out by starting at the first word of the text; the cut ends at (date) before the label (b).
notices.boundary_unsure: Edges are certain. The statute also requires the seller's name and business address on the card; that is not part of the wording, so it is not in the cut and the contract must carry it separately. The statute alternatively accepts the FTC door-to-door statement in place of this text.

notices.title: Personal solicitation cancellation card, tear-off part (CONTRACT CANCELED)
notices.trigger: Over $25; skip when the buyer contacted the seller first
notices.format: Same card as MT-cancel: capital and lowercase letters of not less than 10-point boldfaced type with the seller's name and business address
notices.support: the statement set forth in subsection (1)(b)
notices.summary_row: Notice of right to cancel (cancellation card)
notices.block: MCA 30-14-505. Notice of right to cancel
notices.quote_note: None: the statute does not use quotation marks. The paragraph label (b) is left out by starting at the first word of the text.
notices.boundary_unsure: Edges are certain: the text ends at (Buyer's signature) and subsection (2) starts on the next line. The tear-off must be printed together with MT-cancel as one card.

changes.new: Only for a contract between a general contractor and an owner for the construction of a new residence (MCA 28-2-2201); no written-contract rule for remodels or service work found
changes.support: Montana has one, 28-2-2201, but only for "a contract between a general contractor and an owner for the construction of a new residence". It does not reach remodels, tile, pools, hardscape or cleaning.

unsure: MT-cancel: now cut out of the 30-14-505 block in two parts (see the next entry).
MT-defect: printing a short notice of 70-19-426, 70-19-428 and 70-19-427 in the contract would meet the law, but no official wording exists to copy.

MT-cancel / MT-cancel-slip: the two parts (a) and (b) of 30-14-505(1) are loaded as two notices because the paragraph label (b) sits between them in the block; they form one tear-off card and must print together, with the seller's name and business address which the statute also requires but does not word.
